clips.title: The story
paras: In Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil gathers Twilight Whisker for his brew. Twilight runners carry the whiskers in the northern heights of the Stonetalon Mountains.

Twilight runners prowl the high crags near Stonetalon Peak. Hunters prize their pelts, while Witch Doctor Jin'Zil of Malaka'jin wants their stiff whiskers for a darker purpose. He seeks vengeance on night elves captured after defending these woodlands. To mock and poison his captives, Jin'Zil gathers resinous sap, countless eyes, fey dragon scales, and Twilight Whisker for a lethal draught he calls forest magic.
